subject: CRM Accuracy Sprint: Normalize amounts, SKUs, and Next Steps
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Oliver Park <oliver@acme-tech.com>
Cc: Acme Tech Sales Ops <salesops@acme-tech.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: CRM Accuracy Sprint: Normalize amounts, SKUs, and Next Steps

Team / Acme —

Quick note to kick off a short CRM accuracy sprint focused on the Acme book so our August forecast is trustworthy. Over the last two reviews we found a handful of deals where: amounts don't match finalized SOWs, SKUs are inconsistent (free-text vs. canonical product IDs), and Next Steps are missing or stale which is skewing commit probability.

Goal: get all Acme-tagged open opportunities in HubSpot normalized (amount, SKU, next-step, probability) by end of day Tuesday (48 hours).

Why now: finance needs a clean commit list for the month close and we want to avoid last-minute crediting or manual adjustments.

Primary asks (owners in parens):
- Reconcile amounts vs. signed/near-final SOWs (Ben, Laura) — flag any >10% discrepancies.
- Normalize product/SKU fields to canonical IDs using the attached SKU-mapping-reference.xlsx (Marissa) — add a single canonical SKU in the SKU field, keep free-text in notes.
- Standardize Next Step text to one of: Demo Scheduled, Legal Review, PO Pending, Implementation Kickoff (Evelyn) — set probability accordingly.
- Mark commit status (Commit / Commit at Risk / Upside) and add a one-line rationale when changing probability (Jonas).

Attached: CRM-export-Aug22.csv (current open ops filtered by Acme), SKU-mapping-reference.xlsx, SOW-draft-Acme.docx (latest from legal). I also added the HubSpot deal link for the big opportunity: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-12345

Please reply with a short status update against the checklist below and ETA for completion per owner. If you need Acme to confirm line-item pricing or SOW language, Oliver, can you weigh in quickly so we don't block?

Checklist (reply inline):
- Amount reconcile (Ben / Laura): 
- SKU canonicalization (Marissa): 
- Next Step standardization + probability (Evelyn): 
- Deal-level commit rationale added (Jonas): 

Thanks — I want this to be surgical: 48-hour turnaround, focused edits in the CRM only (no mass overwrites).

Jonas
Senior Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CRM-export-Aug22.csv (csv), SKU-mapping-reference.xlsx (xlsx), SOW-draft-Acme.docx (docx)

From: Oliver Park <oliver@acme-tech.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Tech Sales Ops <salesops@acme-tech.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CRM Accuracy Sprint: Normalize amounts, SKUs, and Next Steps

Jonas —

Thanks for the heads up. We can turn around confirmations on the three deals you highlighted (ACME-12345, ACME-12367, ACME-12402) by EOD tomorrow. A couple quick clarifications:

- For amount reconciliation, use the SOW-draft-Acme.docx as the source of truth for line-item prices; we'll confirm any negotiated discounts in a follow-up email.
- For SKUs, we have internal product codes that differ from your canonical IDs. If you share the SKU mapping file, my ops team will map our codes to yours and reply with the mapping.
- Next Step: we prefer the "PO Pending" state be used only when a signed PO is expected within 7 calendar days. Anything longer should be "Commit at Risk."

I'll loop in our Sales Ops contact (salesops@acme-tech.com) and ask them to push the mapping back to you within 24 hours.

—Oliver
Head of Strategic Accounts
Acme Tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Oliver Park <oliver@acme-tech.com>, Acme Tech Sales Ops <salesops@acme-tech.com>
Date: 2027-08-22T11:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CRM Accuracy Sprint: Normalize amounts, SKUs, and Next Steps

On Sun, Aug 22, 2027 at 8:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team / Acme —
> 
> Quick note to kick off a short CRM accuracy sprint focused on the Acme book so our August forecast is trustworthy.

Thanks Jonas — I pulled the export and started a pass on the highest-ARR deals first. Short status and plan below. I'm attaching the cleaned sample rows (CRM-export-clean-sample.csv) to show format; will not overwrite live until we confirm mapping.

Quick status:
- Ben/Laura: tagged 3 deals with amount mismatches >10% and added a comment with the SOW reference. One deal (ACME-12345) looks like a unit-price vs. total mix-up, Ben will follow up with Acme legal.
- SKU canonicalization: I created a mapping sheet (SKU-mapping-reference.xlsx) and started applying canonical IDs to the SKU field for ~8 deals. I kept the original product name in the line-item notes column.
- Next Step normalization: standardized Next Step values across 22 deals to the canonical list. Set probabilities: Demo Scheduled -> 40%, Legal Review -> 60%, PO Pending -> 90%, Implementation Kickoff -> 100%.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- Ben: finish amount reconcile for the 12 remaining deals (EOD 2027-08-22). If any SOW conflicts, flag for legal + Acme ops.
- Laura: cross-check currency and tax lines for deals with international invoicing (EOD 2027-08-22).
- Evelyn: apply Next Step canonicalization to the remaining open deals and add one-line rationale when changing probability (EOD 2027-08-23 11:59 AM PDT).
- Jonas: review commit rationale for any deal moved to "Commit" and sign off (by 2027-08-23 3:00 PM PDT).

Notes for Acme Ops: Oliver — thanks for agreeing to map your internal codes. Please send the mapping file back to me (Marissa) and I'll align our canonical values to avoid overwrite collisions. 

I'm leaving comments on the high-ARR opportunities in HubSpot as I work so owners have a record. Link: https://hubspot.com/deal/ACME-12345

Marissa Cole
Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: CRM-export-clean-sample.csv (csv), SKU-mapping-reference.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-23T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CRM Accuracy Sprint: Normalize amounts, SKUs, and Next Steps

Quick update —
- Amounts: reconciled 10/12 remaining deals; two require Acme confirmation (ACME-12345, ACME-12402). I added comments and attached the reconciled rows to the HubSpot deal records.
- SKU mapping: applied canonical IDs to all deals Marissa flagged; awaiting Acme mapping for crosswalk verification.
- Next Steps: Evelyn completed canonicalization for the high-ARR set; remaining low-ARR deals scheduled for tonight.

I'll follow up with Acme legal on ACME-12345 and ping Oliver for the PO timelines. On track for Jonas to do final commit sign-off by 3pm PDT today.

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations Analyst
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: reconciled_amounts_sample.csv (csv)
